changes.summary: Now computed; Terraform populates the value from the API when it is not set in configuration.
No longer computed; set this explicitly in configuration if you need a specific callback mode.
Removed from non-callback media settings blocks such as media_settings_chat, media_settings_message, and media_settings_email.
Removed from non-callback media settings blocks such as media_settings_chat, media_settings_message, and media_settings_email.
Removed from non-callback media settings blocks such as media_settings_chat, media_settings_message, and media_settings_email.
Now uses the shared media settings schema instead of an email-specific schema that included deprecated auto-dial fields.
State is automatically migrated from schema version 1 to version 2, removing deprecated auto-dial fields from non-callback media settings in stored state.
Attribute type changed from list to set; order is no longer significant and duplicate values are not allowed.
Optional boolean (defaults to false) that controls station persistent WebRTC on line properties.
Use genesyscloud_telephony_providers_edges_site_outbound_route resources to manage site outbound routes instead.
State is automatically migrated from schema version 1 to version 2, removing outbound_routes from stored state.
Resource operations no longer require the ENABLE_STANDALONE_OUTBOUND_ROUTES environment variable for create, read, update, delete, export, or data source lookup.
Terraform emits a warning when type is omitted, noting that it will become required in a future release.
When multiple flows share the same name, lookup uses type to select the matching flow; if multiple matches exist and none match the requested type, lookup fails with an error.
The data source emits a warning when type is omitted, noting that it will become required in a future release.
When multiple flows share the same name, lookup uses type to select the matching flow; if multiple matches exist and none match the requested type, lookup fails with an error.
canned_response_library_mode is populated from the API during refresh when not set in configuration.
media_settings_callback.mode is no longer auto-populated from the API; omitting it in configuration may produce plan diffs where a value was previously computed.
library_ids is stored and compared as a set rather than an ordered list, which can change plan output when list order previously differed from API order.
Refresh reads and writes line_base.station_persistent_webrtc_enabled from line base properties.
Read no longer runs post-read state consistency validation, which may change plan output for existing resources.
Create, read, and update no longer manage inline outbound_routes; outbound routes must be managed with genesyscloud_telephony_providers_edges_site_outbound_route resources.
Create, read, update, and delete succeed without setting ENABLE_STANDALONE_OUTBOUND_ROUTES.
Create and update send line_base.station_persistent_webrtc_enabled to the Genesys Cloud API.
Flow enumeration during export now paginates through all results instead of stopping after the first page, so large organizations export the full flow inventory.
Export preserves zero values for idle_token_timeout_seconds.
Export runs without requiring ENABLE_STANDALONE_OUTBOUND_ROUTES.
Bulk export skips users that lack an ID or email address.
